spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes a real marketplace. An applied upsert is a listing a buyer can buy, and an applied delist removes one. This tool cannot undo either.

The pricing you send here must match the preview. A different multiplier or floor rebuilds a different plan, the token will not match, and the call is refused rather than applying something the person never saw.
A token mismatch means live state moved since the preview, usually a sale. Call the preview again, show the person what changed, and do not reuse the old token.
It is not idempotent. Each call applies the next batch, so repeating a call with a fresh token applies more changes. Read remainingActionCount and stop when it is zero.
A per-action failure is reported in results with its own error and does not stop the rest of the batch. Report every failed action to the person by name.
It never removes a listing SpellBook cannot match to local inventory. Those stay blocked and are reported, never delisted.

description: Send a previewed batch of changes to ManaPool, creating, repricing and removing real listings. Takes the previewToken from spellbook_manapool_sync_preview, which must still be valid. Applies at most maxActions in one call and returns remainingActionCount with nextActionCursor, so a full book takes several calls. Show the person the preview before the first call, not after.

floorUsd.description: Must match the floorUsd used to build the preview, or the token is refused.

maxActions.description: Maximum actions to apply in this call, 1 to 250. Omit for the default of 50; call again with the same token to continue.

multiplier.description: Must match the multiplier used to build the preview, or the token is refused.

previewToken.description: The previewToken from spellbook_manapool_sync_preview. Must still be valid; a stale token is refused.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose previewed changes to apply. Required.

name: spellbook_manapool_sync_apply
